title: Worst-case Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd algorithm with average-case correct quantum Fourier transform
summary: In [\href{https://quantum-journal.org/papers/q-2022-12-07-872/}{Quantum 6, 872, 2022}], Linden and de Wolf proposed a lightweight protocol for verifying average-case correctness of the quantum Fourier transform (QFT). They showed that good average-case QFT performance is sufficient for good worst-case performance in several quantum information-processing tasks. In this work, we study whether such average-case guarantees are also sufficient when the QFT is used coherently inside the Harrow--Hassidim--Lloyd algorithm. We show that the original average-case condition is not quite strong enough…
